hook.name: useZoomUIToolkit
hook.description: Reads live session, audio, video, device, share, participant, and chat state, plus effective session options and the provider client.
hook.signature: useZoomUIToolkit(): ZoomUIToolkitStates & { sessionOptions: SessionOptions; client: typeof VideoClient | null }

returns.shape: Live session state, effective session options, and the Video SDK client passed to the provider.

keys.name: sessionOptions
keys.description: Effective session configuration after provider defaults are applied.

keys.name: client
keys.description: The Video SDK client passed to ZoomUIToolkitProvider, or null outside the provider or when the provider has no client.

keys.name: sessionState
keys.description: Session connection status, session details, and errors.

keys.name: deviceState
keys.description: Available media devices, selected device IDs, and device-switching state.

keys.name: shareState
keys.description: Screen-share state: whether you are sharing or receiving a share, the share privilege, and annotation state.

keys.name: participantState
keys.description: Session participants, active speakers, and participants sharing their screens.

keys.name: chatState
keys.description: Chat messages, recipients, privilege, availability, and unread count.

notes: Safe to call outside ZoomUIToolkitProvider: client is null and sessionOptions holds the defaults. State values update only while a ZoomUIToolkitProvider with a client is mounted, and every component on the page reads the same state, so mount only one provider.

audioState.isJoined, audioState.isMuted, and videoState.isVideoOn follow the local participant only while a component that controls that media is mounted: AudioButton or VideoButton, the matching SettingsPanel tab, or your own component that calls useAudioController or useVideoController. ZoomUIToolkitApp and Toolbar include AudioButton and VideoButton unless visibleButtons leaves them out.

Before a session connects, every state object holds its initial values with your sessionOptions applied, for example connectionState 'Closed', audioState.isMuted true, videoState.isMirrored true, shareState.sharePrivilege MultipleShare, chatState.privilege All, and empty participant, device, and chat lists. When the connection changes to Reconnecting, Closed, or Fail, all seven state objects return to these values, and connectionState shows the new state.
Components that call this hook re-render whenever any of the seven state objects changes.
This hook only reads state. To perform actions, use useAudioController, useVideoController, useShareController, useRecordingController, the built-in components, or the Video SDK client directly.
hook.returnType: ZoomUIToolkitStates & { sessionOptions: SessionOptions; client: typeof VideoClient | null }

types.name: ZoomUIToolkitStates
types.description: The seven live state objects returned by useZoomUIToolkit.

fields.name: sessionState
fields.description: Session connection status, session details, and errors.

fields.name: audioState
fields.description: Current local audio state.

fields.name: videoState
fields.description: Current local video state.

fields.name: deviceState
fields.description: Available media devices, selected device IDs, and device-switching state.

fields.name: shareState
fields.description: Screen-share state: whether you are sharing or receiving a share, the share privilege, and annotation state.

fields.name: participantState
fields.description: Session participants, active speakers, and participants sharing their screens.

fields.name: chatState
fields.description: Chat messages, recipients, privilege, availability, and unread count.

types.name: SessionState
types.description: Session connection status, metadata, pending actions, errors, and original-host status.

fields.name: connectionState
fields.description: Current session connection status.

fields.name: sessionInfo
fields.description: Session details such as topic and sessionId. Filled in when the session connects.

fields.name: isJoining
fields.description: True while a join started from the built-in JoinButton is in progress. Stays false if you call client.join() yourself.

fields.name: isLeaving
fields.description: True while a leave started from the built-in LeaveButton or the recording consent dialog is in progress. Stays false if you call client.leave() yourself.

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.description: Latest error from joining with JoinButton, leaving, ending, or assigning a new host with LeaveButton, answering a recording consent prompt, or a failed connection. null when there is no current error.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Reason reported by the Video SDK for the latest connection change. Failed LeaveButton and recording consent actions also write their error here. null when there is none.

fields.name: isOriginalHost
fields.description: Whether the local participant joined with an original-host token (role_type: 1). Resets to false if the session reconnects or ends.

types.name: AudioState
types.description: Local audio status and settings.

fields.name: isJoined
fields.description: Whether the local participant has joined audio. Updated only while AudioButton, the SettingsPanel Audio tab, or a component that calls useAudioController is mounted.

fields.name: isMuted
fields.description: True when the local microphone is muted. Always true while not joined. Updated under the same conditions as isJoined.

fields.name: isLoading
fields.description: True while joining, leaving, muting, or unmuting audio.

fields.name: noiseSuppression
fields.description: The noise suppression value applied when audio is joined, taken from sessionOptions.audio.noiseSuppression (default false). setNoiseSuppression does not change it; see noiseSuppressionEnabled for the current setting.

fields.name: noiseSuppressionEnabled
fields.description: Current background noise suppression setting, when known. Undefined until audio is joined with AudioButton or useAudioController, or the setting is changed in this session. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: originalSound
fields.description: Current original sound setting, when known. Undefined until changed in this session. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: headsetSync
fields.description: Current headset button synchronization setting, when known. Undefined until changed in this session. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Latest audio error, or null when there is no error.

types.name: VideoState
types.description: Current local camera status, settings, and virtual background readiness.

fields.name: isVideoOn
fields.description: True when the local camera is active for the current user. Updated only while VideoButton, the SettingsPanel Video tab, or a component that calls useVideoController is mounted.

fields.name: vbImageId
fields.description: Selected background ID: '' for none, 'blur', or one of your image IDs. It returns to sessionOptions.video.virtualBackground.defaultVirtualBackgroundImageId when the connection state changes or when you pass a new sessionOptions object, so keep sessionOptions stable (for example with useMemo).

fields.name: virtualBackgroundImageList
fields.description: Available background choices: the built-in None (id '') and Blur (id 'blur') entries, followed by the valid custom images from sessionOptions. The built-in entries' names are English only and their url is not an image, so show your own translated labels and no thumbnail for them.

fields.name: isVirtualBackgroundReady
fields.description: Whether the Video SDK virtual background model is ready. Before offering virtual backgrounds, also check useVideoController().canUseVirtualBackground.

fields.name: isMirrored
fields.description: Whether the local camera preview is mirrored. Defaults to true and resets to true if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: hardwareAccelerationReceiving
fields.description: Whether hardware acceleration is enabled for receiving video (decoding). Starts false and turns true automatically once it can be enabled. useVideoController().setHardwareAcceleration also changes it. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: hardwareAccelerationSending
fields.description: Whether hardware acceleration is enabled for sending video (encoding). Starts false and turns true automatically once it can be enabled. useVideoController().setHardwareAcceleration also changes it. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: isLoading
fields.description: True while video is starting or stopping. For camera switches, use useZoomUIToolkit().deviceState.isSwitchingCamera.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Latest video error, such as a camera, mirroring, or virtual background failure, or null when there is no error.

types.name: ShareState
types.description: Whether you are sharing or receiving a share, the share privilege, shared-video optimization, and annotation state.

fields.name: isSharing
fields.description: True when the local user is currently screen-sharing.

fields.name: isReceivingShare
fields.description: True while a screen share from another participant is being received.

fields.name: sharePrivilege
fields.description: Who may share in this session. Starts as MultipleShare and updates when the host or a co-host changes it.

fields.name: isEnableOptimizeForSharedVideo
fields.description: True after useShareController().toggleOptimizeForSharedVideo or the "Optimize for video clip" option in ShareButton's sharing controls turns optimization on. Resets to false when your share ends. Not updated by the optimizedForSharedVideo start option or by direct Video SDK calls.

fields.name: annotation
fields.type: { canDoAnnotation: boolean; canUndo: boolean; canRedo: boolean; isAnnotationStarted: boolean; isEnableViewerAnnotation: boolean; isShowAnnotatorName: boolean; }
fields.description: Screen-share annotation availability, active state, and viewer/name-display settings. canUndo and canRedo are reserved and always false.

types.name: ParticipantState
types.description: Session participants, the local participant, active speakers, and screen-sharing participants.

fields.name: participants
fields.description: All participants in the session, including the local participant.

fields.name: currentUser
fields.description: The local participant, or null before joining.

fields.name: activeVideoUser
fields.description: The participant whose video most recently became active or inactive, as reported by the Video SDK. ActiveSpeakerView shows this participant. null until the first report.

fields.name: activeSpeakers
fields.description: Participants the Video SDK most recently reported as speaking, loudest first.

fields.name: activeShareUsersList
fields.description: Other participants currently sharing their screens, in the order they started. Your own share is not included; see shareState.isSharing.

fields.name: activeShareUser
fields.description: The participant whose received screen share the Video SDK reports as active. ShareViewerView shows this share by default. null when no received share is active.

types.name: ChatState
types.description: Chat messages, recipients, permissions, unread-message status, and the current draft and pending send.

fields.name: messages
fields.description: Chat history available to the local participant.

fields.name: receivers
fields.description: Available chat recipients, including the entry for everyone (userId 0).

fields.name: privilege
fields.description: Who can send chat messages in this session.

fields.name: isAvailable
fields.description: Whether chat is ready to use in the connected session.

fields.name: unreadCount
fields.description: Number of unread text messages from other participants received since the session connected. Deleting an unread message lowers it. Cleared whenever the chat panel opened from ChatButton shows the latest message, for example when it opens or the user scrolls to the bottom. There is no public way to clear it from a custom chat UI.

fields.name: unreadMessageIds
fields.description: IDs of the messages counted in unreadCount. Cleared at the same time as unreadCount.

fields.name: draftMessage
fields.description: Unsent message. Preserved when chat reopens or a different recipient is selected. Clears after a successful send. If the selected recipient is unavailable, the panel clears the draft and selects the first available recipient when open or reopened. Also clears when the connection reconnects, closes, or fails.

fields.name: receiverId
fields.description: Selected recipient ID. '0' means Everyone; an empty string means no recipient is selected.

fields.name: pendingSendId
fields.description: Identifier of the send pending for the current draft, or null when no send is pending. Preserved when chat reopens. Use pendingSendId !== null to check whether the draft is sending.

types.name: DeviceState
types.description: Available media devices, selected devices, and device-switching status.

fields.name: cameras
fields.description: Available cameras. Empty until the session connects.

fields.name: microphones
fields.description: Available microphones. Empty until the session connects.

fields.name: speakers
fields.description: Available speakers. Empty until the session connects.

fields.name: activeCameraId
fields.description: Selected camera ID. Falls back to the default or first available camera. null when no camera is known, including before the session connects.

fields.name: activeMicrophoneId
fields.description: Selected microphone ID. Falls back to the default or first available microphone. null when no microphone is known, including before the session connects.

fields.name: activeSpeakerId
fields.description: Selected speaker ID. Falls back to the default or first available speaker. null when no speaker is known, including before the session connects.

fields.name: isSwitchingCamera
fields.description: Whether a camera change is in progress.

fields.name: isSwitchingMicrophone
fields.description: Whether a microphone change is in progress.

fields.name: isSwitchingSpeaker
fields.description: Whether a speaker change is in progress.

types.name: MediaDevice
types.description: An available microphone, speaker, or camera.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Device name for display.

fields.name: deviceId
fields.description: Device ID to pass when selecting a microphone, speaker, or camera.

types.name: MediaWarning
types.description: An audio or video error, such as denied permission or a failed operation.

fields.name: type
fields.description: 'permission' when microphone or camera access is denied, 'operation' when an action fails. 'unknown' is reserved and not currently produced.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Details about the failure, when available. It may be a Video SDK error code or reason (for example 'INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES') rather than a user-facing sentence, so show your own text based on `type`.

types.name: SessionOptions
types.description: Audio, video, recording, and session behavior configured through ZoomUIToolkitProvider.

fields.name: audio
fields.description: Audio defaults and host unmute-request consent settings.

fields.name: video
fields.description: Video defaults, including custom virtual background images and the initially selected background.

fields.name: recording
fields.description: Recording consent dialog configuration.

fields.name: session
fields.description: Reclaim-host banner setting.

types.name: AudioOptionType
types.description: Configuration accepted by SessionOptions.audio.

fields.name: noiseSuppression
fields.description: Whether AudioButton and useAudioController turn on background noise suppression when they join audio. Default false.

fields.name: disableUnmuteConsentDialog
fields.description: Hides the dialog that AudioButton shows when the host asks you to unmute. Default false.

types.name: VideoOptionType
types.description: Configuration accepted by SessionOptions.video.

fields.name: virtualBackground.virtualBackgroundImageList
fields.description: Custom background choices { id, name, url }. Entries with an empty name or url, a duplicate id, or a reserved id ('' or 'blur') are ignored. The effective list starts with the built-in None and Blur choices.

fields.name: virtualBackground.defaultVirtualBackgroundImageId
fields.description: Default background ID: '' for none, 'blur', or an ID in the configured list. Invalid IDs fall back to ''. The default is reapplied when the connection state changes or when you pass a new sessionOptions object.

types.name: SessionOptionType
types.description: Configuration accepted by SessionOptions.session.

fields.name: disableReclaimHostBanner
fields.description: Set to true to stop ZoomUIToolkitProvider from showing the banner that lets the session's original host take back the host role ("Reclaim host") while someone else is host. Default false.

types.name: ConnectionState
types.description: Session connection status.

values.name: Connected
values.description: Joined the session. Start audio and video separately.

values.name: Reconnecting
values.description: The session is reconnecting after a connection interruption.

values.name: Closed
values.description: Initial value before joining. Also reported when the session closes.

values.name: Fail
values.description: The SDK reports a connection failure.

types.name: RecordingOptionType
types.description: Configuration accepted by SessionOptions.recording.

fields.name: disableRecordingConsentDialog
fields.description: Hides the recording consent dialogs that ZoomUIToolkitProvider shows when a recording needs your consent. Default false.

types.name: Participant
types.description: Zoom Video SDK Participant type, also exported by this package.

types.name: SharePrivilege
types.description: Share privilege enum from the Zoom Video SDK. Import it with `import { SharePrivilege } from '@zoom/videosdk'`.

values.name: Unlocked
values.description: One participant can share at a time; only the host or a co-host can start sharing while someone else is sharing.

values.name: Locked
values.description: Only the host or a co-host can share.

types.name: VirtualBackgroundImage
types.description: A virtual background choice. Use this shape for images you pass in `sessionOptions.video.virtualBackground.virtualBackgroundImageList`. `videoState.virtualBackgroundImageList` also starts with the built-in None (id '', url '') and Blur (id 'blur', url 'blur') choices, whose names are English only.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique image ID. The values '' and 'blur' are reserved for no background and blur. If an ID is reserved or repeated, only the first entry with that ID is kept.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Non-empty accessible label for the image. Supply a translated label for your application. Entries with empty names are ignored.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Non-empty image URL. Entries with empty URLs are ignored.

types.name: VideoClient
types.description: The Zoom Video SDK client returned by ZoomVideo.createClient(). Import the type with `import type { VideoClient } from '@zoom/videosdk'` and write it as `typeof VideoClient`. Call client.init() yourself before passing the client to ZoomUIToolkitProvider.

types.name: SessionInfo
types.description: Session details from the Video SDK, also exported by this package. Filled in when the session connects; before that, text fields are empty, userId is 0, and isInMeeting is false. Contains the session password, so do not log or display it.

fields.name: topic
fields.description: Session topic.

fields.name: password
fields.description: Session password, if one is set.

fields.name: userName
fields.description: Local participant's display name.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Local participant's user ID.

fields.name: isInMeeting
fields.description: Whether the local participant is in the session.

fields.name: sessionId
fields.description: Session ID.

types.name: ChatMessage
types.description: Zoom Video SDK chat message type, also exported by this package.

types.name: ChatReceiver
types.description: A chat recipient. userId 0 is the entry for everyone. Exported by this package.

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Recipient user ID.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Recipient display name.

fields.name: isHost
fields.description: Whether the recipient is the host.

fields.name: isManager
fields.description: Whether the recipient is a manager (co-host).

types.name: ChatPrivilege
types.description: Chat privilege enum from the Zoom Video SDK. Import it with `import { ChatPrivilege } from '@zoom/videosdk'`.

values.name: EveryonePublicly
values.description: Everyone can send public messages, but not private messages.
